specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D RPG VFX sprite sheet, ultra crisp painterly animation, transparent RGBA background. EXACT evenly spaced 4 columns by 3 rows = 12 equal square animation cells, 1536x1152 canvas, no cell outlines, no text, no labels, no background, generous fully transparent 12% margin inside EVERY cell, nothing crosses a cell boundary. Chronological left-to-right then top-to-bottom. The shapes and material breakup must actually evolve across every cell; do not repeat static icons. Palette: incandescent ivory-gold core, solid antique-gold structure, crimson red accents, restrained warm embers. Strong legible silhouettes and substantial opaque cores survive small-size display. NO birds, phoenix, wings, feathers, animals, creatures, summoning circles, runes, characters, hands, weapons other than arrows. Alpha transparency must be real; no checkerboard painted into pixels. Asset: arrow-draw charge animation centered at 50% x 50% in each cell. A horizontal narrow luminous arrow pointing right materializes from inward gold filaments, progresses into a very dense faceted gold arrowhead and straight shaft, compressed air crescents pulled back to the left, peak tension at frame 7, sudden forward string-release pressure crescent at frame 8, 9-12 splintered residual light vanishing. Much more like charging a devastating arrow than a magic ball. No bow or character. The emission point remains the center.
